title: Heat Inactivate FBS
author: Cody Roberts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdg7i3zn

steps.title: Acclimate or refrigerate serum
steps.instruction: Allow the frozen serum to acclimate at room temperature for a minimum of 10 minutes, or refrigerate it overnight at 2 °C – 8 °C.

steps.title: Thaw serum uniformly
steps.instruction: Thaw the serum either by letting it melt completely at room temperature or by placing the bottle in a 37 °C water bath; avoid temperatures above 37 °C or prolonged thawing to prevent precipitates. Swirl the bottle every 10–15 minutes during thawing to disperse released salts and proteins.

steps.title: Prepare 56 °C water bath
steps.instruction: Set up a temperature‑controlled water bath at 56 °C, ensuring there is enough water to fully submerge the entire contents of all serum bottles.

steps.title: Fill control bottle with water
steps.instruction: Fill a control bottle (identical to the serum bottles) with water; the water temperature should match that of the thawed serum.

steps.title: Place bottles and thermometer
steps.instruction: Place the control bottle and all serum bottles into the 56 °C water bath. Suspend a calibrated thermometer into the control bottle, making sure it does not touch the sides or bottom of the bottle.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate serum
steps.instruction: When the thermometer reads 56 °C, start a 30‑minute timer. Maintain the water bath at 56 °C for the entire period and gently swirl all bottles every 3–5 minutes to keep the serum uniform.

steps.title: Finish heating
steps.instruction: After 30 minutes, remove the heat‑inactivated serum bottles from the water bath and give each bottle one final gentle swirl.

steps.title: Aliquot serum
steps.instruction: In a cell‑culture hood, aliquot the serum into ten 50 mL containers (50 mL per container).

steps.title: Store and label serum
steps.instruction: Store the aliquoted, heat‑inactivated serum at –20 °C in a frosted freezer and label each container as “Heat Inactivated FBS”.

steps.title: Cautionary notes
steps.instruction: Avoid protein precipitates by (1) proper thawing, (2) thorough homogeneous mixing before inactivation, (3) not exceeding the recommended 56 °C temperature, and (4) not extending the inactivation beyond the recommended 30 minutes.
